hooks.command: cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/AGENTS.md" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Project rules from AGENTS.md. These are authoritative and override default behaviour. CLAUDE.md only points here.\n\n" + .)}}'

jq -r ".tool_input.command" | grep -qE "(jest|(npm|yarn|pnpm)( run)? test[a-z:]*)[^|;&]*( -u( |$)|--updateSnapshot|--update-snapshot)" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Blocked by project policy: never auto-update Jest snapshots. Show the user the failing snapshot diff and stop. Do not run jest -u / --updateSnapshot and do not hand-edit .snap files. See AGENTS.md.\"}}" || true
